status_curl.png:
A single game status icon, one object only, centred, drawn as flat cartoon art.

The object: a small animal curled up into a tight defensive ball, seen from the side, so that only its rounded armoured back shows - warm chestnut brown with a few thick banded plates across it, a stubby striped tail tucked in at the bottom, one small ear folded flat against the ball. A closed, compact, unbreakable-looking sphere

It is shown at about 40 pixels across in the game, so it must read from its silhouette and its main colour alone: one bold shape, high contrast, no fine detail, no small parts.
Draw it SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with a little soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no hand, no character, no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green in the object.
Output 512x512 PNG. Save the image as status_curl.png in the current directory and report the path.
